## Recommended objective

Correct issue #69 (bug: activity-log prefetch guard checks X-Inertia-Prefetch, but Inertia sends Purpose: prefetch) so the session, announcement, and calendar view loggers skip the `Purpose: prefetch` header sent by the shipped Inertia client while continuing to log real navigation once.

## Approved boundary

This behavior is within CHG-54 (Extend the Activity Log to signed-in user activity), which already requires preventing prefetch false positives. The planned code, test, and documentation changes are limited to the three view guards, `UserActivityTest.php`, and `application/ops/activity-logging.md`.

Keep the existing activity data and schema unchanged. Do not include the separate Q&A redirect defect in issue #68 (bug: every Q&A action also logs a session_viewed (redirect back to the session page)). Do not change participant-data rules, event meanings, providers, production behavior, or approved product scope.

## Acceptance result

1. Prefetch requests for sessions, announcements, and calendar pages send `Purpose: prefetch` and produce no matching view event.
2. Tests use the header sent by the actual Inertia client, not `X-Inertia-Prefetch`.
3. Real navigation still produces exactly one matching event.
4. Operations guidance matches the implemented and tested behavior.
